title: Agent Hooks
subtitle: Run commands automatically when selected agent events occur

activation.title: Agent Hooks
activation.description: Commands run as the user running OpenBitFun; enable hooks only from trusted sources

projectHooks.label: Enable project hook file
projectHooks.description: Allow commands from the workspace's .openbitfun/config/hooks.json; enable only for trusted projects

projectHooksRisk.title: Allow workspace code to run Hooks?
projectHooksRisk.message: When enabled, .openbitfun/config/hooks.json in “{{workspace}}” can run commands with your user permissions. Enable this only for a workspace you trust after reviewing its Hook file.

locations.title: Where hooks are declared
locations.description: Changes to hooks.json take effect without restarting OpenBitFun.

userFile.label: User hook file
userFile.description: config/hooks.json in the OpenBitFun user config directory.

projectFile.label: Project hook file
projectFile.description: .openbitfun/config/hooks.json in the current workspace. Requires Enable project hook file.

imports.title: Imported hooks
imports.description: Review and manage hooks imported from Claude Code or Codex.
imports.masterDisabled: Imported hooks are preserved, but the master switch prevents them from running.
imports.remoteUnsupported: Imported hooks are unavailable for remote workspaces.
imports.loadFailed: Imported hooks could not be loaded.
imports.refreshFailed: Imported hooks could not be refreshed.
imports.empty: No imported hooks. Refresh to check Claude Code and Codex.

state.source_missing: The source is missing; the reviewed snapshot remains available
state.update_check_failed: The update check failed; the reviewed snapshot remains available
state.bundle_missing: Managed files are missing; review the source again to repair them

imports.planFailed: The hook import could not be prepared for review.
imports.reviewWarning: These commands run with your account privileges. Confirm only after reviewing every command and dependency below.
imports.stale: The source changed. Nothing was written; review this refreshed plan.
imports.applyFailed: The reviewed hook import could not be applied.
imports.applied: Imported hooks are enabled for the next matching event.
imports.appliedDisabled: The reviewed update was applied; these imported hooks remain disabled.
imports.appliedMasterDisabled: Imported hooks are ready but will not run until Enable hooks is turned on.
imports.stateChanged: Imported hook state changed. Review the refreshed state and try again.
imports.updateFailed: Imported hook state could not be updated.
imports.removeSourceUntouched: Only OpenBitFun's managed copy is removed. The Claude Code or Codex source is not changed.
imports.resetWarning: This removes the invalid OpenBitFun-managed index for this scope. Source application files are not changed.

compatibility.title: Codex compatibility
compatibility.description: OpenBitFun uses the Codex Hooks contract and can run compatible hook scripts directly.

messages.loadFailedLocked: Hook settings could not be read. Related switches are locked to avoid enabling command execution by mistake.

discovery.title: Discovered external hooks
discovery.description: Inspect hook declarations from DeepSeek Harness, PI, and OpenCode; discovery does not import or execute them
